# Audex Trace

Audex Trace is a macOS Apple Music mini player for Lossless and Hi-Res listeners.

Official site: https://trace.audex.dev/

Download: https://github.com/audexdev/trace-releases/releases/download/v1.1/AudexTrace-1.1.zip

Release notes: https://github.com/audexdev/trace-releases/releases/tag/v1.1

Changelog: https://trace.audex.dev/changelog.html
Privacy: https://trace.audex.dev/privacy.html

Current version: 1.1

Minimum macOS version: macOS 15

Primary supported player: Apple Music on macOS

Key features:
- Apple Music mini player for macOS
- Playback format readout for codec, bit depth, and sample rate
- Output sample-rate match status
- Experimental Auto Sample Rate Match
- Menu bar and notch player views
- Built-in Compatibility Check before purchase

Pricing:
- Free download
- Audex Trace Pro launch offer: $19.99 one-time purchase
- Regular price: $24.99 one-time purchase
- No subscription

Known limitations:
- Apple Music Song Transitions, AutoMix, or Crossfade can make playback-format detection delayed or unavailable around track changes.
- Auto Sample Rate Match depends on the output device exposing compatible macOS sample rates.
- macOS 14 and earlier are not officially supported.

Privacy summary:
- Playback format detection runs locally using Music.app state and local playback metadata/log signals.
- Audex Trace does not modify, enhance, record, or upload audio.
- License verification, update checks, purchase checkout, and artwork fallback may use the network.
- No listening history is uploaded for audio-quality detection.
- No Apple Music account sign-in or cloud library API access is required.
- No analytics are used for the initial beta.

FAQ:

Q: What is Audex Trace?
A: Audex Trace is a macOS mini player for Apple Music that shows playback format details such as codec, bit depth, sample rate, and output match status.

Q: Does Audex Trace change Apple Music audio?
A: No. Audex Trace does not modify, enhance, record, or upload audio. Playback format detection runs locally on the Mac.

Q: Can Audex Trace automatically match the Mac output sample rate?
A: Audex Trace Pro includes experimental Auto Sample Rate Match for compatible output devices that expose matching macOS sample rates.

Q: Which macOS version does Audex Trace require?
A: Audex Trace requires macOS 15 or later and the Apple Music app.

Q: Where can I download Audex Trace?
A: Audex Trace is distributed through GitHub Releases from the official site at https://trace.audex.dev/.
